description: This JavaScript file contains functions related to UI interactions such as toggling user preferences display and selecting an organization within a web application. It appears to be part of a web frontend for the Rainbowstone theme in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: showHideUserPref()
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the user details section by changing its display style between 'none' and 'block'.

methods.name: selectOrgaOK(orgaName)
methods.description: Handles organization selection by simulating a click on the specified organization element and hiding the modal dialog.
